proposals.before: On xinhai Kong Xun of Heyang retired as grand preceptor.
proposals.after: On xinhai Kong, former Heyang military commissioner, retired as grand preceptor to the heir apparent.
proposals.reason: The Chinese names only 孔, not 孔循; later s0054 names 孔循 as a different official. The idiomatic given name Xun is invented and collides with Kong Xun.

proposals.before: On xinyou Mao Zhang became right gold spears senior general, Hua Wenqi right gold spears grand general, and Zhang Qianzhao Zheng defense commissioner.
proposals.after: On xinyou Mao Zhang became right gold spears senior general, Hua Wenqi right gold spears grand general, and Zhang Qianzhao Zhengzhou defense commissioner.
proposals.reason: Zhang Qianzhao Zheng fuses the person with Zhengzhou; Chinese is 張虔釗為鄭州防禦使.

proposals.before: On jiaxu Lady Cao became Shufei and Lady Wang Defei, with enfeoffment days to be set.
proposals.after: On jiaxu Lady Cao became Shufei and Lady Wang became Defei, with investiture days to be set.
proposals.reason: Lady Wang Defei fuses the person with the new rank; Chinese treats 王氏 and 德妃 as name plus title.

proposals.before: On dinghai Guo Chengfeng of Tiande received inspector grand guardian.
proposals.after: On dinghai Guo Chengfeng of Tiande received Inspector-in-Chief of Works.
proposals.reason: 檢校司徒 is not Grand Guardian (太保); the literal already has Inspector-in-Chief of Works.

proposals.before: On dingsi Wang Jingzhan became Hua commissioner and Li Congwen Xing commissioner.
proposals.after: On dingsi Wang Jingzhan became Hua commissioner and Li Congwen became Xing commissioner.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English fuses Li Congwen with the place-name Xing.

proposals.before: On gengshen, former Fu prefecture military commissioner Zhai Zhang was made Xinzhou Weisai Army regent.
proposals.after: On gengshen, former Fu prefecture prefect Zhai Zhang was made Xinzhou Weisai Army regent.
proposals.reason: Chinese 刺史 is prefect, not military commissioner.

proposals.before: Former Zheng prefecture military commissioner Yang Hanbin was made Yangzhou Wuding Army regent.
proposals.after: Former Zheng prefecture prefect Yang Hanbin was made Yangzhou Wuding Army regent.
proposals.reason: Chinese 刺史 is prefect, not military commissioner.

proposals.before: On wuchen Chen Gao became Feng Wuxing regent, Sun Hanzhao Ying Zhangguo regent, Fan Yanguang privy commissioner, Zhang Yanlang southern privy commissioner, Lou Jiying Yao training commissioner, and Zhang Tingyun Jin defense commissioner.
proposals.after: On wuchen Chen Gao became Feng Wuxing regent, Sun Hanzhao became Ying Zhangguo regent, Fan Yanguang privy commissioner, Zhang Yanlang southern privy commissioner, Lou Jiying became Yao training commissioner, and Zhang Tingyun became Jin defense commissioner.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English fuses several personal names with their postings.

proposals.before: A Taibai Mountain Daoist, Jie Yuan'gui, came from Sichuan, met Mingzong informally, and claimed to be 111.
proposals.after: A Taibai Mountain Daoist, Jie Yuan'gui, came from Sichuan, met Mingzong informally, and claimed to be 101.
proposals.reason: Chinese 一百一歲 is 101, not 111.

proposals.before: At the time the Taibai Mountain Daoist Jie Yuan'gui came from Sichuan, was received in the informal hall, and claimed to be one hundred eleven years old.
proposals.after: At the time the Taibai Mountain Daoist Jie Yuan'gui came from Sichuan, was received in the informal hall, and claimed to be one hundred one years old.
proposals.reason: Chinese 一百一歲 is 101, not 111.

proposals.before: On jiashen Princess Yongning was enfeoffed to Lady Shi and Princess Xingping to Lady Zhao, with enfeoffment days to be set.
proposals.after: On jiashen the Emperor's third daughter Lady Shi was enfeoffed Princess Yongning and the thirteenth daughter Lady Zhao Princess Xingping, with enfeoffment days to be set.
proposals.reason: Chinese confers princess titles on the emperor's daughters 石氏 and 趙氏; the idiomatic English reverses that relation.

proposals.before: On renyin Wang Yanqiu reported attacking the rebel city on the twenty-second of the sixth month with three thousand wounded.
proposals.after: On jiayin Wang Yanqiu reported attacking the rebel city on the twenty-second of the sixth month with three thousand wounded.
proposals.reason: Chinese 甲寅 is jiayin, not renyin (壬寅).

proposals.before: On renyin Wang Yanqiu reported that on the twenty-second of the sixth month he attacked the rebel city; three thousand officers and men were wounded.
proposals.after: On jiayin Wang Yanqiu reported that on the twenty-second of the sixth month he attacked the rebel city; three thousand officers and men were wounded.
proposals.reason: Chinese 甲寅 is jiayin, not renyin.

proposals.before: On guimao court mourned Crown Prince junior tutor Li Maoxun.
proposals.after: On yimao court mourned Crown Prince Junior Guardian Li Maoxun.
proposals.reason: Chinese 乙卯 is yimao not guimao; 太子少保 is Junior Guardian, not junior tutor.

proposals.before: On guimao court was suspended for mourning because Crown Prince Junior Tutor Li Maoxun died.
proposals.after: On yimao court was suspended for mourning because Crown Prince Junior Guardian Li Maoxun died.
proposals.reason: Chinese 乙卯 is yimao; 少保 is Junior Guardian, not Junior Tutor.

proposals.before: On the guiyou new moon of the eighth month Li Yun and Liu Xu, Hanlin academicians, became revenue vice ministers; Liu Yue of Personnel acted as library director; Han Yanhun of Personnel as rites minister; Gui Ai of Revenue as crown prince guest; Pei Hao of Revenue as war vice minister; Zhang Wenbao as punishments vice minister.
proposals.after: On the guiyou new moon of the eighth month Li Yi and Liu Xu, Hanlin academicians, became revenue vice ministers; Liu Yue of Personnel acted as library director; Han Yanhun of Personnel as rites minister; Gui Ai of Revenue as crown prince guest; Pei Hao of Revenue as war vice minister; Zhang Wenbao as punishments vice minister.
proposals.reason: 懌 is Yì, not Yún; the idiomatic English personal name Li Yun mistranslates 李懌.

proposals.before: Eighth month, guiyou new moon: Hanlin academician and acting Secretariat drafting officer Li Yun and Liu Xu were both made Vice Ministers of Revenue in office; Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Yue acted as Director of the Imperial Library; Vice Minister of Personnel Han Yanhun acted as Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Revenue Gui Ai acted as Crown Prince Guest; Vice Minister of Revenue Pei Hao acted as Vice Minister of War; Secretariat drafting officer Zhang Wenbao acted as Vice Minister of Punishments.
proposals.after: Eighth month, guiyou new moon: Hanlin academician and acting Secretariat drafting officer Li Yi and Liu Xu were both made Vice Ministers of Revenue in office; Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Yue acted as Director of the Imperial Library; Vice Minister of Personnel Han Yanhun acted as Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Revenue Gui Ai acted as Crown Prince Guest; Vice Minister of Revenue Pei Hao acted as Vice Minister of War; Secretariat drafting officer Zhang Wenbao acted as Vice Minister of Punishments.
proposals.reason: The literal English likewise renders 李懌 as Li Yun instead of Li Yi.

proposals.before: On xinmao Han Pu, Shuofang acting commissioner, became Shuofang commissioner, Lingwu-Gansu surveillance commissioner, and honorary Minister of Works.
proposals.after: On xinmao Han Pu, Shuofang acting commissioner, became Shuofang commissioner, surveillance commissioner of Lingwu, Xiong, Jing, Gansu, and other prefectures, and honorary Minister of Works.
proposals.reason: 雄 and 警 are prefecture names in the Shuofang surveillance title, not an omitted adjective in the Lingwu-Gansu shortening.

proposals.before: On xinmao Shuofang army acting commissioner Han Pu was made Shuofang army military commissioner, Lingwu martial-alert Gansu and other prefectures surveillance commissioner, and honorary Minister of Works.
proposals.after: On xinmao Shuofang army acting commissioner Han Pu was made Shuofang army military commissioner, surveillance commissioner of Lingwu, Xiong, Jing, Gansu, and other prefectures, and honorary Minister of Works.
proposals.reason: Literal English mistranslates 雄警 as martial-alert instead of the prefectures Xiong and Jing.

proposals.before: On wushen Zhao Dejun presented captives; Tiyin and fifty barbarian generals joined the personal guard; six hundred other Khitan were beheaded.
proposals.after: On wushen Zhao Dejun presented captives; the barbarian general Tiyin and fifty others were kept in the personal guard; six hundred other Khitan were beheaded.
proposals.reason: 蕃將惕隱等五十人 totals fifty including Tiyin, not Tiyin plus fifty generals.

proposals.before: Wen Wei of Xiangyi did not avenge his father's killer though a settlement petition existed; a special edict ordered execution.
proposals.after: Wen Wei of Xiangyi, whose father had been killed by someone, did not avenge his father; though there was a petition to settle, a special edict ordered execution.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic sentence makes the killer the object of avenge and flattens 有狀和解, obscuring the legal ground.

proposals.before: Winter, tenth month, jiachen: Princess Qionghua of the Chang clan, née Meng, may be enfeoffed as Princess of Fuqing.
proposals.after: Winter, tenth month, jiachen: Grand Princess Qionghua, née Meng, may be invested as Grand Princess Fuqing.
proposals.reason: 長公主 is the rank Grand Princess, not a Chang clan; 孟氏 is the surname Meng, and 冊為 is investiture as 福慶長公主.

proposals.before: On jiazi Gao Xinggui of An reported Left Divine Swift and Left Huaihun garrison mutiny driven out and killed beyond the walls.
proposals.after: On jiazi Gao Xinggui of An reported Left Divine Swift and Left Huaishun garrison mutiny driven out and killed beyond the walls.
proposals.reason: 懷順 transcribes as Huaishun, not Huaihun.

proposals.before: That day Zhang Xichong—Khitan-appointed at Ping, grand guardian and grand preceptor by inspection—became Ru prefect and grand tutor by inspection.
proposals.after: That day Zhang Xichong—Khitan-appointed Pingzhou prefect, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and acting Grand Guardian—became Ruzhou prefect and was additionally acting Grand Tutor.
proposals.reason: 光祿大夫 is omitted or blurred; 檢校太保 is Grand Guardian not Grand Preceptor; 加檢校太傅 is an additional acting Grand Tutor.

proposals.before: On jiawu Wang Jianli—left vice director, councilor, Hall of Assembled Worthies director, and Three Bureaus commissioner—became Qing commissioner, grand preceptor by inspection, and councilor.
proposals.after: On jiawu Wang Jianli—left vice director, councilor, Hall of Assembled Worthies director, and Three Bureaus commissioner—became Qing commissioner, acting Grand Commandant, and councilor.
proposals.reason: 檢校太尉 is acting Grand Commandant, not Grand Preceptor.

proposals.before: Mingzong said: "Only he, Guo Chongtao, and Li Jilin had received them from the prior reign—and Chongtao and Jilin were soon wiped out; his own peril might come any day."
proposals.after: Mingzong said: "Only I, Guo Chongtao, and Li Jilin had received them from the prior reign—and Chongtao and Jilin were soon wiped out; my own peril might come any day."
proposals.reason: 惟朕 is first-person; the idiomatic rendering turns the emperor into he and his.
